summary: Binance Labs has rebranded to YZi Labs, and the old Binance Labs incubation page is not publicly available. YZi Labs now describes EASY Residency as its 10-week in-person incubation program, but no current application deadline or cohort dates were found on official pages.

sources.title: YZi Labs - Official Site
sources.supports: Official site states Binance Labs rebranded to YZi Labs and describes YZi Labs as investing in Web3, AI, and biotech.

sources.title: EASY Residency - YZi Labs
sources.supports: Official program page describes EASY Residency as a 10-week in-person incubation program with hands-on coaching, curriculum, and networking, but does not publish current application dates.

sources.title: YZi Labs FAQ
sources.supports: Official FAQ says EASY Residency supports founders at idea, MVP, and growth stages and accepts startups globally.

notes: The submitted website https://labs.binance.com/incubation-program no longer exposes a current Binance Labs Incubation Program page in available public sources.
I did not create a proposed event because the named Binance Labs Incubation Program appears superseded by YZi Labs/EASY Residency, and current application or cohort dates are not publicly stated.
Closest taxonomy if later entered: types incubator/program, supports mentorship/resources, sectors web3/ai/bio, region global.
